call.speech.closing.back: Farewells: goodbye, bye, we'll talk (hear each other), we'll talk tomorrow, we'll talk tomorrow (one word), take care, take good care, see you, see you tomorrow, so long for now, have a nice weekend, farewell, look after yourself. Wrap-ups: that's all, I have to hang up, I'll call later, I'm not keeping you, thanks for the call. Ends: Thank you very much for the help, goodbye. / Let's do that then, we'll talk tomorrow. / Okay, then it's settled, take care. Not ends: Hi, this is Anna from the bank, we hear from each other rarely, but now it's about your account. / He left the meeting without saying goodbye, but what did you think of the proposal? / Do you think we can hear each other better now that I closed the window?
call.speech.closing.note: Added the whole goodbye people actually say, with tomorrow in it: vi hörs i morgon, vi hörs imorgon, vi ses i morgon. Bare hörs stays out. verified is false; a native speaker still needs to check the wording.
